description: This file defines a REST controller named AnswerController, which handles CRUD operations related to answers associated with questions in a Spring Boot application. It provides endpoints to get, add, update, and delete answers linked to specific questions.

classes.name: AnswerController
classes.description: Spring REST controller managing Answer resources related to questions.

methods.name: getAnswersByQuestionId
methods.description: Retrieves a list of answers for a specific question.

methods.name: addAnswer
methods.description: Adds a new answer to a specific question.

methods.name: updateAnswer
methods.description: Updates an existing answer linked to a question.

methods.name: deleteAnswer
methods.description: Deletes an answer associated with a question.

methods.name: getAnswersByQuestionId
methods.description: Handles GET request to retrieve answers for a question.

methods.name: addAnswer
methods.description: Handles POST request to add an answer to a question.

methods.name: updateAnswer
methods.description: Handles PUT request to update an existing answer.

methods.name: deleteAnswer
methods.description: Handles DELETE request to remove an answer.
